description: Agent CLIs that install as native programs from their makers' installers: Grok Build (xAI, grok), Muse Code (Meta, muse; a 350 MB download) and Antigravity CLI (Google, agy); no Node needed

steps.name: Grok Build from xAI's installer
steps.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://x.ai/cli/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

steps.name: Muse Code from Meta's installer
steps.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

steps.name: Antigravity CLI from Google's installer
steps.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

steps.name: grok, muse and agy on every program's path
steps.run: home=$(eval echo "~$AGENT_VM_BOX_USER") && mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && ln -sfn "$home/.grok/bin/grok" /usr/local/bin/grok && ln -sfn "$home/.local/bin/muse" /usr/local/bin/muse && ln -sfn "$home/.local/bin/agy" /usr/local/bin/agy

update.name: Grok Build, the newest
update.run: latest=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://x.ai/cli/stable) && current=$(~/.grok/bin/grok --version 2>/dev/null | cut -d ' ' -f 2) && [ -n "$latest" ] && [ "$latest" = "$current" ] && { echo "Grok $current is the newest"; exit 0; }; f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://x.ai/cli/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

update.name: Muse Code, the newest
update.run: f=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-all-errors https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh -o "$f" && bash "$f" < /dev/null; status=$?; rm -f "$f"; exit $status

update.name: Antigravity CLI, the newest
update.run: for attempt in 1 2 3; do ~/.local/bin/agy update < /dev/null && exit 0; sleep 15; done; exit 1

update.name: grok, muse and agy on every program's path
update.run: home=$(eval echo "~$AGENT_VM_BOX_USER") && mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && ln -sfn "$home/.grok/bin/grok" /usr/local/bin/grok && ln -sfn "$home/.local/bin/muse" /usr/local/bin/muse && ln -sfn "$home/.local/bin/agy" /usr/local/bin/agy
